name: Tracklayer autorouter
description: Autoroute the open board: exact-geometry (shape) or grid engine, any number of copper layers.
description_full:
Tracklayer routes the unrouted nets of the open board and adds the tracks and vias as one undoable change, then refills the zones. The shape engine works on exact geometry: every obstacle is grown by the clearance plus half the track width and tracks run corner to corner, so clearances are met exactly and tight escapes from fine-pitch pads just work. The grid engine gives classic 45-degree tracks. Net classes, locked and hand-routed copper, keep-outs and pours are respected. Any number of copper layers with through vias.

Tools > External Plugins > Tracklayer autoroute. Pure Python, needs nothing beyond KiCad.
